products.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. A luxury perfume brand called CIRCUIT for AI developers. Design language: restrained industrial minimalism, precision hardware, quiet technical confidence, smoked glass, brushed titanium cap, tiny etched circuit-board traces as a tasteful material detail, minimal ivory monospaced label. No RGB lights, no screens, no computer props. Photorealistic editorial product photograph, soft neutral studio illumination, front three-quarter view, entire object visible with generous transparent padding. Output one isolated product on actual transparent alpha; no backdrop, no floor, no pedestal, no cast shadow, no watermark. Required brand word exactly CIRCUIT spelled C I R C U I T, clean readable label; no other text except requested variant name. Create the hero 50 ml eau de parfum: a squat rectangular bevelled smoky charcoal glass bottle with rounded precise corners, brushed titanium cuboid cap, visible warm pale liquid, one fine mint circuit trace running vertically along the right side of the glass. Minimal label text exactly CIRCUIT and CORE. Premium real perfume packaging, not an electronic device.
